fields.label: Category Code
fields.description: Used in MOH report element rules ({"category": ...}). Cannot be changed after saving.

fields.label: Form
fields.description: 705A: under 5 years; 705B: 5 years and over. A category not on the patient's form is counted under the catch-all.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Alternatives of one condition (for example Malaria, Injuries). Within one encounter (or internal-referral chain) only the group's highest-priority categories count.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Higher wins within the group. Equal priorities all count.

fields.label: Catch-all (All other diseases)
fields.description: Exactly one category. Unmapped diagnoses are counted here and listed as exceptions.

fields.label: Excluded (not counted)
fields.description: Diagnoses mapped here are not counted on 705A/705B (for example contacts with health services).

fields.label: Requires Laboratory Confirmation
fields.description: Counts only when the encounter, or another encounter of its internal-referral chain, has an approved (submitted) result listed below; otherwise the diagnosis counts under the fallback category.

fields.label: Positive Results
fields.description: One result value per line, exactly as the test's options (case is ignored).

fields.label: Seed Marker
fields.description: "Seed v1": still as shipped, so a later seed may update it. "Edited": changed in the desk; seeds never touch it again. Blank: created in the desk.
